header: Ticked, crossed, and a word at the end
lead: A dense list where every row answers yes or no. The optional qualifier at the end of a row is what keeps an honest yes from becoming a misleading one.
note: Reach for the spec sheet instead when each row carries a measured value rather than a yes or a no.
